steps.text: In a food processor, place the feta cheese, olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, sun-dried tomatoes and oregano. Using the pulse setting, blend the mixture until smooth. Transfer to a medium bowl. Blend in the olives by hand or with a spoon. Refrigerate until serving.

raw_recipe.headline: Greek Feta And Olive Spread
raw_recipe.description: Feta cheese, sun-dried tomatoes and black olives come together as one in this full-flavored Greek dip. Serve it on toasted triangles of pita bread.
raw_recipe.name: Greek Feta And Olive Spread

recipeInstructions.text: In a food processor, place the feta cheese, olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, sun-dried tomatoes and oregano. Using the pulse setting, blend the mixture until smooth. Transfer to a medium bowl. Blend in the olives by hand or with a spoon. Refrigerate until serving.

review.reviewBody: FANTASTIC!! You have to be fond of feta cheese and greek flavorings, however. I used kalamata olives instead. I made this then spread it on whole wheat tortillas, laid roasted red peppers in a strip down the middle and rolled them up. Then I cut them (carefully) into pinwheels. Everyone RAVED about them! The spread is awesome. Thanks for a great recipe!

I read all reviews and combined with another recipe very similar...It was so wonderful and people will want the recipe! Here is what I did: I combined sour cream, 1/3 less fat cream cheese and feta cheese...approx. 8 oz. of each and added some olive oil, lemon juice, green onions, sun dried tomatoes, garlic, oregano. After blending those, I folded in Kalamata olives and a few more chopped sundried tomatoes!!!! Served with toasted french baguette slices and whole grain toasted pita chips....Wonderlicious!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!

This recipe is fantastic. I have made it twice in the last week after discovering it, and my boyfriend and I devoured it with a spoon both times. It is so good! I used kalamata olives, and used the sun dried tomato oil instead of the olive oil the recipe called for. Absolutely delicious.

Absolutely delicious! I used fat-free feta and it was marvelous! I read these reviews beforehand and took the advice to mix in the sun-dried tomatoes with the olives and it came out very pretty! Great dip for veggies or pitas and a huge hit with my friends!

I found the salty taste did not diminish with time, and it definitely isn't appetizing to look at, buuuuut everyone loved it, as did I. Once you have a taste, you just keep going back for more. It grows on you. To make it look better, I garnishd with a drizzle of olive oil, a few whole kalamatas, some of the chopped sundried tomatoes, and a sprinkle of the crumbled feta.

This recipe has everything that is good and perfect in Mediterranean cuisine! I used sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil and kalamata olives (go for the Kalamata!). I also had to add a bit more olive oil - I think it will vary depending on the moisture content of your feta cheese (mine was pre-crumbled so I think it was a bit drier than a whole block of feta). Also paired it with Lavash cracker bread from this site and it paired well.
Delicious! I added some fresh mint and a sprinkle of cayenne - sooo savory & yummy, I had to stop myself from eating it by the spoonfulls! Great recipe!
This was a huge hit and so easy to make. Just a few changes- replaced oregano with basil, bit more olive oil and Athena brand Mediterranean Herb feta. Yummy!

So, so good!!! Nom nom nom!!! Made this tonight as an appetizer and we loved it!! All I had was Wheat Thins to go with it but it was great just the same. Very simple recipe. Was short on time so I made it, put it in the freezer for about 20 minutes and it was perfect! Thanks!!

This recipe was delicious and so easy to make! The only thing I changed was that I used kalamata olives instead of plain black olives - and it was so wonderful! I served it with sliced baguette. I couldn't believe how much flavor was packed into each mouthful! It was a hit at the party I brought it to. I will definitely make this one again. It's a nice orangish-red color, so I served it in a a green shallow dish with a sprig of fresh thyme on top. Beautiful and delicious!

Excellent! My co-workers raved about this, and I couldn't stop eating it! It is VERY good! I did add a little extra lemon juice to thin it out slightly, but it was still better to spread than dip. I will definitely make this again.
Absolutely delish! Used kalamata olives.

I couldn't believe how so much flavor resulted with a simple recipe! I used this as a tapenade on a veggie sandwich which improved the normal sandwich considerably. The remainder will be used as a spread for crackers or tortilla chips. Wonderful!
Delicious and so easy to make! Would highly recommend this to anyone.
I like feta,and all the foods with it.Maybe,the next time when I will eat it I put some savory.....

This would be a five star but the calories are calculated for one serving of 2 tbs. This is SO yummy, there's no way that is a serving. 
I didn't closely measure the ingredients, as I was using up things in my frig. I soaked dried sun-dried tomatoes in hot water for 20 min. I threw all of the ingredients into my food processor at one time. 
So good!

This is delicious! I was buying a spread that was just like this ...& it wasn't cheap. I looked at the ingredients, then saw your recipe..it's almost the same so I've adopted your recipe instead of buying the other one. Thanks for sharing!
We had something similar at a restaurant and just loved it. This was so good and we added Franks RedHot Sauce...excellent! No longer need to go out to get it!
This was another favorite at my family get-together in Prior Lake, MN. Jerry loved it. This will be a good recipe to bring to an upcoming party.
SO, SO SO VERY RICH. WONDERFUL FLAVOR. MY HUSBAND HAS MADE THIS ABOUT 3 TIMES NOW.
